method.duration: 180 elapsed seconds per revision after the first natural timer poll
method.execution: Independent server/browser processes measured during overlapping windows; CPU is per-server ps time, not host CPU
method.isolation: Private fixture copies, tests/conftest.py state overrides, loopback only, external browser requests blocked, Orca disabled
method.transport: Sandbox Funnel registry selects the production metadata no-store branch on baseline; loopback HTTP, no live TLS/proxy changes
method.bytes: Compressed response bodies and HTTP response wire bytes including headers; excludes bootstrap, TLS and TCP overhead
method.routes: Five actual idle GETs observed; metadata supplies project/delivery summaries, no board configured, review document rather than plan tab
method.fixture_note: The supplied copy contains 191 version files/history entries, rather than the task description's 265; source metadata 937735 B, private owner-stripped copy 936659 B
method.timer_note: Unmodified 2.27.2 shell.js, actual adaptive 8/15/30 second timers, no synthetic refresh or fetch loop
method.review_execution: Final code remeasured for 180 seconds during independent sandboxed test runs; recorded baseline retained; CPU is per-server ps time.

before.notes: Real browser timers, warmed bootstrap excluded; private copy and isolated state, no external traffic; no synthetic polling.

after.notes: Real browser timers, warmed bootstrap excluded; private copy and isolated state, no external traffic; no synthetic polling.

validation.coverage: All ten poll route families, exact representation SHA-256, gzip/identity, 304 empty bodies, meta/project/owner/delivery invalidation, auth/session isolation and key rotation, bounded cache; mapped edits with unchanged stat fields, non-object JSON, atomic migration/bootstrap and shared offline-close lock

pre_review_after.notes: Real browser timers, warmed bootstrap excluded; private copy and isolated state, no external traffic; no synthetic polling.

findings_fixed: Stat-only metadata cache served stale 304 after repeated mmap edits; key now hashes the exact parsed source bytes.
Non-object JSON metadata disconnected HTTP requests; normalize to empty metadata while retaining live summaries.
Legacy migration could overwrite an existing comments.json in place; replace atomically under the server store lock.
Initial generation exposed an empty or partial comments.json; initialize atomically under the same lock.
Offline close took a different lock from the HTTP server; use the shared store lock and atomic writer.

writer_audit.server: All v2 mutations and legacy-store conversion use atomic helpers under _locked_store.
writer_audit.cli: publish/withdraw and finding changes use shared helpers or the API; close fixed here; claim and names write metadata, not comments.
writer_audit.backfill: Apply and restore use _atomic_bytes under the page store lock.
writer_audit.hooks_mcp: Hooks only read comments; MCP writes delegate to the local API or shared CLI helpers.
writer_audit.staging: Consolidation writes into a private staging directory installed by rename; benchmark in-place writes affect private test copies only.
writer_audit.cache_contract: Keep stat signatures for comments.json: supported production writers replace files atomically; arbitrary external in-place/mmap edits are outside this writer contract.
